svg.text: RAG Modulo: Evolution Timeline
From first commit to archive — 22 months, 446 PRs
May–Jul 2024: Vector Store Foundation
First commit. Built Milvus, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB stores.
Async vector stores. Docker Compose + Makefile. React UI scaffold.
"fixing milvus_storev2.py WIP" / "getting closer on milvus_store.py" / "happy with elasticsearch"
~40 commits, 1 PR
Pure human, learning Python
Aug–Oct 2024: Team Collaboration
Contributors join: @mtykhenko (build/infra), @luizerico (frontend/UI), @jslecointre (MLFlow).
Repository pattern. Auth system. Poetry. CI/CD pipeline. Collection UI.
PRs #2-#22: Settings UI, Header fixes, Collection page, Build adjustments, Tests in containers
~20 PRs, 4 contributors
Human team building core
Nov–Dec 2024: RAG Feature Build-Out
Replace genai SDK with WatsonX. Question suggestion. Async search. MLFlow eval.
Document processing. Source page numbers. Query rewriting (then removed). OCP deploy.
Multi-provider architecture: Anthropic + OpenAI + WatsonX (#71). Config management refactor.
PRs #30-#99: "Removed query rewriting to improve search results" / "Add new providers architecture"
~50 PRs, 36 merged
Intensive human feature work
Feb–Jul 2025: Development pause (~6 months)
Aug–Sep 2025: AI-Driven Revival
Return with Claude Code as primary tool. Massive linting (643 issues). MyPy fixes. Test pyramid.
Chain of Thought reasoning (#230). Conversation interface (#232). CLI auth. DevContainers.
Defensive programming cleanup (7 phases). GHCR migration. Security scanning foundation.
"feat: Implement comprehensive Chain of Thought reasoning" — first major Claude-authored feature
~60 PRs, AI co-authored
Claude Code enters the picture
Oct 2025: Feature Explosion (98 PRs merged)
Podcasts. Docling. Reranking. Secret scanning (3-layer). Reusable UI components.
Search re-architecture from ground up (#551). N+1 query detection. Token tracking.
Codex workflow experiment (PRs #367-382 — 16 PRs trying to automate, all failed).
Peak velocity. Also peak AI slop accumulation (agents, commands, skills piling up).
98 merged PRs in 1 month
Peak velocity + peak mess
Nov 2025: Consolidation + Deployment Saga
Conversation refactoring (7 phases, PRs #576-#592). Structured output (#626). MCP Gateway (#684).
TRUNCATE_INPUT_TOKENS bug (#564). Deployment death march (#633-#640, 7 PRs for 1 deploy).
SPIFFE/SPIRE architecture. 106-file cleanup (#584, -26K lines). Terraform + Ansible + Helm.
82 PRs merged. The "fix the AI's mess" month — but also shipped MCP server + structured output.
82 PRs, 7 hotfixes
Ship + fix + ship + fix
Dec 2025 – Feb 2026: Quiet Period
MCP Server (#715). New contributor @mtykhenko fixes frontend PID tracking.
User dedup fix (#721). Dependency bumps. README corrections.
6 PRs in 3 months
Maintenance mode
Mar 2026: Performance Sprint + The Great Cleanup
AI slop cleanup: -44,777 lines (#760). Trivy supply chain attack fix (#766).
CoT auto-detection fix — 8s savings (#769). Hallucination investigation (#773/#775).
DI optimization saga: 8 sequential PRs (#778-#785). PipelineContext: 48 queries → 3.
The month where the hard lessons crystallized. LESSONS_LEARNED.md written.
12 PRs, -44K lines
Cleanup + optimization
May 2026: Archived
1,934 commits. 446 PRs. 2,615 tests. LESSONS_LEARNED.md as the final artifact.
